notes.title: Satellite Rush is here! Thank you all Early Access players!
notes.notes:
Finally, Satellite Rush is out of its Early Access!
We'd like to thank every one of you who played our game during Early Access, who talked to us at conventions, and who supported Satellite Rush and Kimeric Labs during all this time.

Now go play our Release Version! And if you're new here, welcome to the  Satellite!

notes.title: Meet the Host!
notes.notes:
The latest update has the addition of the Host, a master of ceremonies to welcome you into the Satellite and let you know how things work over here.

Some slight UI changes and bug fixes are were also added.
Have fun!
